parser_family: jxmlease _DictSAXHandler node builder over CPython 3.14 pyexpat over Expat 2.10.0, namespace processing off (raw names); shares the Expat XML parser family with projects/xml/python/xmltodict, untangle, defusedxml, xmlschema and the standard xml.etree.ElementTree path
build_note: jxmlease is installed from the pinned py2.py3-none-any wheel (jxmlease/ checked byte-identical to the sdist); it has no runtime dependencies. Ubuntu's CPython 3.14 pyexpat loads Expat 2.10.0 built from source with clang LLVM source coverage (same Expat pin as projects/xml/python/xmltodict and untangle) through LD_LIBRARY_PATH; pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION is asserted.
api: jxmlease.parse(bytes of a local XML file) with default settings; returned XMLDictNode / XMLListNode / XMLCDATANode tree read through tag, get_xml_attrs() and get_cdata()
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the jxmlease.parse call (jxmlease xmlparser.py, _parsehandler.py and node classes) and LLVM source coverage of source-built Expat 2.10.0 reached through pyexpat
scope: Valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 local files without DOCTYPE through jxmlease.parse with default settings: raw qualified element and attribute names as written (prefix:local; namespace processing is off by default), xmlns/xmlns:* declarations kept as ordinary attributes in source order, per-element stripped character data (CDATA and decoded references included), and tree depth. Same-name siblings are grouped into XMLListNode lists, so document order across differently named siblings is not kept (both controls keep it); comments and processing instructions are not delivered to the node tree, and mixed content is concatenated per element.
parser_options_caveat: jxmlease's default Parser settings (process_namespaces=False, no namespace remapping or stripping) were used. No DTD, entity, malformed-input or generator (streaming) mode was tested.
tested_parser: jxmlease.xmlparser.Parser creating xml.parsers.expat.ParserCreate(encoding, None) itself (process_namespaces=False default; asserted in the image)
raw_name_caveat: Raw-name view, following the C raw-name precedent (projects/xml/c/libnxml/oracle.py): names are reported as written and namespace URIs are never resolved. The summary is compared with an expat non-namespace oracle and, in the feedback check, with an independent lxml/libxml2 parse projected to raw names; no expanded {uri}local name is claimed.
